The bug report requests an API to remove the title information from the tooltip. The root cause is that the `itemRender` function in the `Cascader` component always sets the `title` attribute based on the `showTitle` prop, which defaults to `true`. ### Bug Location The issue is located in the `itemRender` function within the `Cascader` component in the `src/cascader/cascader.jsx` file. We will add a default prop for `showTitle` and modify the `itemRender` function accordingly. ```javascript ### src/cascader/cascader.jsx <<<<<<< SEARCH showTitle: true, ======= showTitle: PropTypes.bool, >>>>>>> REPLACE <<<<<<< SEARCH itemRender: item => { const title = this.props.showTitle ? item.label : undefined; return {item.label}; }, ======= itemRender: item => { const title = this.props.showTitle ? item.label : null; return {item.label}; }, >>>>>>> REPLACE <<<<<<< SEARCH showTitle: true, ======= showTitle: true, >>>>>>> REPLACE ``` This patch ensures that the `title` attribute is only added when `showTitle` is `true`, allowing users to control the display of the title through the `showTitle` prop.
